text:
I recently moved to Pattaya about a year ago, and the clinic accepts the Gold Card (government health insurance). I'm incredibly impressed with the service at The H Smile Pattaya. From Mint, the administrator who handled my appointment, to the excellent service mindset I felt from the moment we started chatting, I was pleasantly surprised. When I actually met Mint at the clinic, she was incredibly lovely – polite, cheerful, and answered all my questions. She helped me a lot, significantly reducing my anxiety about visiting the dentist. This was a truly positive first impression. I sincerely commend them! 🙂

Although it's a small clinic, the equipment, tools, and atmosphere are all clean and tidy. There's a spacious waiting area for both patients and their families, and a clean restroom.

Dr. Pongsakorn, the clinic's resident dentist, is also incredibly kind, patient, polite, and speaks very nicely. He helped break down my fears, providing excellent guidance at every step, explaining what I was doing and what would happen next. This greatly reduced my anxiety and nervousness. Plus, he has a gentle touch; I barely felt any pain. And he's excellent at English! I brought my foreign husband to get dental work done here again, and we were still very impressed. We plan to have regular dental care at The H Smile in the future. 😊

A truly heartfelt thank you for the excellent service from Dr. Pongsakorn, all the assistants, and especially Mint, the receptionist. 🙏

I would highly recommend Dr. Pongsakorn to anyone reading this honest review. He is a truly excellent dentist and very trustworthy. 👍

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมดิเอชสไมล์พัทยา The H Smile Dental Clinic Pattaya
text:
(My doctor asked me to write a review, which was a long time ago.)

This clinic was probably one of the first in Pattaya to participate in the universal healthcare program (Gold Card). That's how I got the chance to use my benefits. Back then, it wasn't as crowded.

Booking: Very easy. Just call the number from Google Maps, mention you're using your Gold Card, and schedule an appointment for a date and time that suits you. (But it's probably difficult now because it's likely much busier.)

The dental experience: The atmosphere during the teeth cleaning wasn't bad; it wasn't uncomfortable. The dentist was very nice, kind, and spoke politely (though he was a little heavy-handed because he was a man). The assistant nurse was also very helpful, making the procedure go smoothly.

Interior: Clean and comfortable. There are large, soft leather sofas to sit on, and they provide extra chairs if needed. There's a large TV screen showing things to watch while waiting. The air conditioning is nice and cool; it's comfortable and not hot.
